proposals.evidence: Turner *jhāla burning/pungent explicitly gives Assamese zāl and Bengali jhāl hot/pungent. These Hajong/Bengali forms match that eastern family; aspiration and the final vowel are preserved. Bishnupriya forms with an additional copula or other ending are not silently shortened.
